WITH
    ['https://WWW.ClickHouse.com/docs', 'https://GitHub.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse', 'https://www.anthropic.com/news'] AS urls
SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> upper(firstSignificantSubdomain(domainWithoutWWW(lower(x)))), urls) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

WITH
    [49.99, 189., 19.5] AS prices,
    [2, 1, 4] AS quantities
SELECT
    arrayMap((p, q) -> concat('$', toString(multiply(p, q))), prices, quantities) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(lower, ['Hello', 'WORLD']) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(trimBoth(_), [' x ', ' y ']) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap((_1 * 2) + 1, [1, 2, 3]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_ + _, [1], [2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_2 - _1, [1], [2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_1 + _1, [1, 2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_2, [1], [2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_2 + 1, [1]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_1 + _2, [1], [2], [3]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_ + _1, [1], [2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_1 + _, [1], [2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_0 + 1, [1]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_129 + 1, [1]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(arrayMap(_ + 1, _1), [[1, 2]]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(arrayMap(x -> (x + _1), [1]), [10]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_1 -> (_1 + 1), [1]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_1 + t.n, [1, 2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type
FROM
(
    SELECT toUInt8(10) AS n
) AS t

SELECT
    (t._1 + t._2) + t._ AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type
FROM
(
    SELECT
        toUInt8(1) AS _1,
        toUInt8(2) AS _2,
        toUInt8(3) AS _
) AS t

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> (x + 1), [1, 2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap((x, y) -> (x + y), [1], [2]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> arrayMap(y -> (x + y), [1, 2]), [10, 20]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    bitOr(1, 2) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(x -> upper(trimBoth(x)), [' x ']) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_ + _, [1]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(_1 + _2, [1, 2], [3]) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(upper(trimBoth(_)), [' x ']) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type

SELECT
    arrayMap(upper(trimBoth(_1)), [' x ']) AS value,
    toTypeName(value) AS type
